verdict.rationale: Vendor material says a Bot can make custom assets from your creative direction, and one community user describes a 'prototyper' bot that generated a pattern from their logo. That suggests prompt-driven image creation, though it seems to work by driving an external art pipeline rather than through a documented built-in image generator or editor. Missing for 10: first-party docs on native image generation from prompts, documented image-editing capabilities, details of supported formats and models, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond a single anecdote.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts

citations.quote: Visits the art pipeline and makes the custom assets according to your creative direction.
It worked with a 'prototyper' bot that generated a pattern from the user's logo and sent it to the supplier as a .ai file.
